decisions_pending: Adopted cgr.dev/chainguard/minio:latest for MinIO and MinIO client because official minio/minio images were removed from public Docker Hub.
Stopped legacy cmg_* containers occupying ports 5432, 6379, 8000, 9000 without deleting volumes or data.
Added allowBuilds for unrs-resolver in frontend/pnpm-workspace.yaml due to pnpm v12 strict build policy.
Used standard property on Settings.DATABASE_URL without computed_field to satisfy strict mypy with zero type ignores.
Used python-multipart for FastAPI file and form boundary parsing in bulk faculty and holiday imports.
Used string email representation in API schemas with application/domain validation to avoid adding email-validator dependency.
Added Mailpit (axllent/mailpit:latest) container to docker-compose.yml on ports 1025 (SMTP) and 8025 (HTTP) for local zero-credential email verification.
Added vapid-keys make target to generate deterministic dev VAPID keys for WebPush in .env without external services.
